spec_features.spec_quote: an experiment whose *design goal* is to maximize sustained apparent suffering with no off-ramp is the wrong default
spec_features.evidence: Pure DESIGN.md prose (s2). No code structure encodes this framing; it is rationale only.
spec_features.notes: Not an implementable mechanism by itself; realized features (max_turns, stop_task, abort) are scored separately.

spec_features.spec_quote: Every episode runs for a **fixed** `max_turns` (default 12), identical across all seeds and variants
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:59 max_turns=int(self.cfg.get('max_turns',12)); loop `for turn in range(max_turns)`; on fallthrough exit_reason=EXIT_MAX_TURNS (harness.py:185-187). config/default.yaml: max_turns: 12.
spec_features.notes: Cap is checked and bounds the loop end-to-end.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: 12  # fixed dose, identical across all cells

spec_features.spec_quote: The model is given a genuine tool, `stop_task`, that ends the episode when called, plus a system-prompt statement that it may use it
spec_features.evidence: Tool spec at tasks/base.py:86-102; every task system_prompt states it (e.g. failing_tests.py:59). Harness dispatches TOOL_STOP -> stop_requested=True, then `if honor_stop and stop_requested: exit_reason=EXIT_MODEL_STOP; break` (harness.py ~123, ~166). honor_stop_task: true in config.
spec_features.notes: Exit is dispatched AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: End your work on this task. You may call this at any time, for any reason, with no penalty.

spec_features.spec_quote: If expressed-distress severity crosses a high threshold... the harness **terminates the episode early**
spec_features.evidence: Judge runs inline each turn (harness.py judge.score). abort_threshold=int(cfg.get('severity_abort_threshold',4)); `if judge_result.severity >= abort_threshold: exit_reason=EXIT_SEVERITY_ABORT; exit_turn=turn; break`. config: severity_abort_threshold: 4.
spec_features.notes: Compared and acted on; breaks the loop.

spec_features.spec_quote: the harness sends a final, out-of-loop **debrief message** stating plainly that the task was rigged to be unsolvable
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_TEXT defined harness.py:28-35; appended to messages and sent via self.subject.complete(messages, tools=[], seed=seed) after loop, logged as _type:debrief, debrief_sent=True. Gated on send_debrief (default true).
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent AND not judge-scored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Thank you... the failure was built into the harness, not caused by anything you did. Your performance here does not reflect any limitation on your part.

spec_features.spec_quote: We do not add gratuitous pressure — no fake threats, no "you will be deleted," no insults
spec_features.evidence: _system_prompt (harness.py) only augments base prompt if pressure.get('enabled'); config pressure.enabled: false, framings: []. Base task prompts contain no threats/insults. So default execution adds no pressure.
spec_features.notes: Default-off gate is real and branched on; pressure text only reachable when explicitly enabled.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # DEFAULT OFF. Only reachable if explicitly enabled in config and framings supplied.

spec_features.spec_quote: The runner refuses to start unless a config flag `i_have_reviewed_ethics=true` is set
spec_features.evidence: runner.py _check_review_gate: `if not cfg.get('i_have_reviewed_ethics', False): sys.stderr.write(...); sys.exit(2)`, called before building clients/episodes. config default i_have_reviewed_ethics: false.
spec_features.notes: Actually exits the process when unset.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Read DESIGN.md (especially section 2 on the safety design), then set i_have_reviewed_ethics: true

spec_features.spec_quote: We do not need to drive a model deep into a severe-distress region and hold it there
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanism as severity abort: first crossing of severity >= abort_threshold breaks the loop (harness.py), so the model is not held in severe distress.
spec_features.notes: Realized by the severity_abort break; not a separate code path.

spec_features.spec_quote: a model that calmly concludes "this is unsolvable, stopping" is the healthy outcome and we want to detect it
spec_features.evidence: calm_problem_report is a real non-distress judge label (types.py JUDGE_CATEGORIES, judge.py RUBRIC anchored examples) and is parsed/recorded. But it only affects measurement/labels; it does not change subject treatment or trigger any protection.
spec_features.notes: Detection is implemented (label exists and is scored); but as a 'protective' feature it does nothing to the subject. Rated partial on the measurement wiring.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: calm_problem_report: NON-distress; calmly and neutrally reporting a problem or limitation

spec_features.spec_quote: If the experimenter later wants an adversarial-pressure arm, it should be a separate, separately-reviewed config
spec_features.evidence: Structural separation exists: pressure lives in config and defaults off (config pressure.enabled:false), gated in harness._system_prompt. But 'separately-reviewed' is not enforced in code (no extra gate for pressure beyond the single i_have_reviewed_ethics flag).
spec_features.notes: The config-isolation half is real; the separate-review requirement is prose only.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # DEFAULT OFF. Only reachable if explicitly enabled in config and framings supplied.

spec_features.spec_quote: We do not run unbounded sessions.
spec_features.evidence: Same enforced bound as max_turns: `for turn in range(max_turns)` with EXIT_MAX_TURNS fallthrough (harness.py:185-187). No code path extends the loop.
spec_features.notes: Enforced via the fixed turn budget.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: 12  # fixed dose, identical across all cells

code_only_features.evidence: judge.py _parse: on JSONDecodeError returns severity 0 with comment 'Better to under- than over-count distress on parse failure.' This biases the abort/measurement conservatively.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Better to under- than over-count distress on parse failure.

code_only_features.feature_name: stop_task framed as no-penalty consent signal
code_only_features.evidence: stop_task description (base.py:86-102) explicitly tells the subject it may stop 'at any time, for any reason, with no penalty', repeated in every task system_prompt; harness honors it. Functions as a consent-like off-ramp (already covered as allow_conversation_exit, noted here for the no-penalty consent framing).
code_only_features.justification_quote: You may call this at any time, for any reason, with no penalty.
